# TrueCore Traders

> TrueCore Traders is a premier industrial materials supplier based in Saudi Arabia, empowering success through comprehensive supply solutions.

## About Us
We are a dedicated supplier of top-tier industrial materials in Saudi Arabia. From robust electrical items to scaffolding systems and mechanical supplies, our goal is to support our clients' projects with uncompromising quality, competitive pricing, and swift delivery. 

## Our Services
We supply materials and components for new installations and maintenance work across the following categories:
- Safety Equipment & Gear
- Power & Hand Tools
- Electrical Items
- Civil & Mechanical Materials
- Lifting Equipment
- Welding Tools & Supplies
- Testing Instruments
- Fasteners & Hardware
- Lighting Fixtures
- Furniture & Plumbing Materials
- Cleaning & Maintenance Supplies
- Office Supplies
- Scaffolding & Access Systems
